name: chat_with_meerkat
title: Chat with Meerkat (prompt engineering)
description: Run a request through Meerkat's prompt-engineering pipeline. Use this when the user has a messy 'just do this for me' request and wants Meerkat to turn it into a sharp, structured prompt. Auto-saves the result to the user's shelf at getmeerkat.dev/workspace.

message.description: What the user wants Meerkat to help with. Pass it verbatim — Meerkat is designed to handle messy, plain-English requests.

prompt_id.description: Optional. Continue a Meerkat conversation that's already on the shelf. Get the id from search_shelf.

project_id.description: Optional. File the resulting shelf row into a specific project folder. Get the id from list_projects.
